title: scleranthus annuus var. biennis
intro: Scleranthus annuus var. biennis, commonly known as the perennial knawel, is a plant species that belongs to the Caryophyllaceae family. It has been traditionally used for its medicinal properties, including its potential health benefits such as reducing inflammation, improving digestion, and acting as an antioxidant. The therapeutic actions of Scleranthus annuus var. biennis include its ability to calm the nervous system, reduce stress and anxiety, and promote relaxation. Bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and essential oils, which contribute to its therapeutic properties.
